source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice mcqs written from Chapter 22 (PDF 186-207), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 22 (Biostatistics) ke poore chapter se practice MCQs hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein. Har sawal ka aik sahi jawab hai aur saath mukhtasar wajah; numerical sawalon mein hal ke qadam diye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt:
1 Biostatistics applies statistical methods and techniques specifically to:
(Biostatistics (hayati shumariyat) statistical methods ko khaas taur par kis data par lagati hai?)

options.text: biological, medical aur sehat se mutaliq data

blocks.explanation: Biostatistics statistical methods ko khaas taur par biological, medical aur sehat se mutaliq data par lagati hai (22.1).

book_ref.quote: applies statistical methods and techniques specifically to biological, medical, and health-related data

blocks.prompt:
2 Biostatistics involves which set of activities on data?
(Biostatistics mein data par kaun se kaam shamil hain?)

options.text: jama karna, pesh karna, analysis aur interpretation
sirf jama karna aur mehfooz karna

blocks.explanation: Is mein data jama karna, pesh karna, analysis (tajziya) aur interpretation (tashreeh) shamil hain taa ke ba-maani nataij nikal sakein (22.1).

book_ref.quote: It involves the collection, presentation, analysis, and interpretation of data to draw meaningful conclusions

blocks.prompt:
3 Biostatistical analysis lets researchers make decisions about populations using sample data because testing entire populations may be:
(Biostatistical analysis sample data se population ke baare mein faisle karne deti hai, kyunke poori population ko test karna ho sakta hai:)
blocks.explanation: Poori population ko test karne ke bajaye sample data istemal hota hai kyunke woh na-qabil-e-amal ya mehnga ho sakta hai (22.1).

book_ref.quote: rather than testing entire populations which may be impractical or costly

blocks.prompt:
4 By studying a representative subset of workers in a population, biostatistics helps to estimate:
(Population ke workers ke aik numainda hisse (subset) ko parh kar biostatistics kya andaza lagane mein madad deti hai?)

options.text: tamam workers mein kisi sehat ki halat ka phailao (prevalence)

blocks.explanation: Workers ke numainda subset ko parh kar tamam workers mein kisi sehat ki halat ke phailao (prevalence) ka andaza lagta hai (22.1).

book_ref.quote: helps estimate the prevalence of a health condition among all workers

blocks.prompt:
5 Formulating the research question, determining objectives and structuring experiments to test a hypothesis is the component called:
(Research ka sawal banana, maqasid tay karna aur hypothesis test karne ke liye experiments ki tarteeb kis component ka hissa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Study design aur experimental planning mein research ka sawal banana, maqasid tay karna aur experiments ya observational studies ki tarteeb shamil hai (22.1.1).

book_ref.quote: This involves formulating the research question, determining objectives

blocks.prompt:
6 Calculating adequate sample size and controlling confounding factors are parts of:
(Munasib sample size nikalna aur confounding factors (uljhane wale awamil) ko control karna kis ka hissa hain?)
blocks.explanation: Study design mein population chunna, variables tay karna, randomization, confounding factors control karna aur munasib sample size nikalna shamil hai (22.1.1).

book_ref.quote: controlling confounding factors, and calculating adequate sample size

blocks.prompt:
7 Proper study design ensures:
(Durust study design kis cheez ki zamanat deta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Durust study design validity (durusti), reliability (bharosa) aur be-laag (unbiased) nataij ki zamanat deta hai (22.1.1).

book_ref.quote: Proper study design ensures validity, reliability, and unbiased results.

blocks.prompt:
8 Using medical records and government reports already available is an example of:
(Pehle se mojood medical records aur government reports istemal karna kis ki misaal hai?)
blocks.explanation: Secondary data collection published research, medical records, government reports aur databases ka mojood data istemal karti hai (22.1.1).

book_ref.quote: Using existing data from published research, medical records, government reports, and databases

blocks.prompt:
9 Data cleaning, coding and storage while maintaining confidentiality and integrity belong to:
(Data ki safai (cleaning), coding aur storage, raazdari aur durusti ke saath, kis component mein aate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Data management and processing jama shuda data ko tarteeb deta hai aur is mein cleaning, coding aur storage shamil hain (22.1.1).

book_ref.quote: It includes data cleaning, coding, and storage, maintaining confidentiality and integrity.

blocks.prompt:
10 Hypothesis testing, regression analysis and modelling are included in:
(Hypothesis testing, regression analysis aur modelling kis mein shamil hain?)
blocks.explanation: Inferential statistics, jis mein hypothesis testing, regression analysis aur modelling hain, sample data se population ke baare mein nataij nikalne deti hai (22.1.1).

book_ref.quote: Inferential statistics, including hypothesis testing, regression analysis, and modelling

blocks.prompt:
11 Mean, median, mode and standard deviation are tools of:
(Mean, median, mode aur standard deviation kis ke auzaar hain?)
blocks.explanation: Descriptive statistics data ki khususiyaat bayan karti hai (mean, median, mode, standard deviation waghera) (22.1.1).

book_ref.quote: Descriptive statistics describe characteristics of the data

blocks.prompt:
12 Translating statistical findings into meaningful biological or health conclusions is called:
(Statistical nataij ko ba-maani biological ya sehat ke nataij mein badalna kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Interpretation of results statistical nataij ko ba-maani nataij mein badalti hai, context, hudood aur mafrozon ko dekhte hue (22.1.1).

book_ref.quote: Translating statistical findings into meaningful biological or health conclusions.

blocks.prompt:
13 Transparency in reporting methods and findings is essential for:
(Methods aur nataij ki reporting mein shaffafiyat (transparency) kis ke liye zaroori hai?)
blocks.explanation: Methods aur nataij ki shaffaf reporting reproducibility (dobara kar sakna) aur bharose ke liye zaroori hai (22.1.1).

book_ref.quote: Transparency in reporting methods and findings is essential for reproducibility and trust.

blocks.prompt:
14 In clinical trials, biostatisticians evaluate:
(Clinical trials mein biostatisticians kya jaanchte hain?)

options.text: nayi dawaon, ilaj aur devices ki hifazat aur asar

blocks.explanation: Statistical methods se biostatisticians nayi dawaon, ilaj aur medical devices ki hifazat aur asar jaanchte hain (22.1.2).

book_ref.quote: evaluate the safety and effectiveness of new drugs, treatments, and medical devices

blocks.prompt:
15 In epidemiology, biostatistics is used to investigate:
(Epidemiology (wabaiyat) mein biostatistics kis ki tehqeeq ke liye istemal hoti hai?)

options.text: population mein bimariyon ka phailao aur asbaab

blocks.explanation: Epidemiology mein biostatistics population mein bimariyon ke phailao aur un ke asbaab (determinants) ki tehqeeq karti hai (22.1.2).

book_ref.quote: investigate the distribution and determinants of diseases within populations

blocks.prompt:
16 Treatments tailored to an individual's genetic profile, where biostatistical methods are essential, are called:
(Woh ilaj jo kisi fard ki genetic profile ke mutabiq banaya jaye, jahan biostatistical methods zaroori hain, kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Personalized medicine mein ilaj fard ki genetic profile ke mutabiq hota hai; is mein biostatistical methods zaroori hain (22.1.2).

book_ref.quote: Biostatistical methods are essential in personalized medicine

blocks.prompt:
17 In public health policy, biostatistics identifies:
(Public health policy mein biostatistics kya pehchanti hai?)

options.text: kamzor groups aur sehat ki na-barabariyan

blocks.explanation: Biostatistics kamzor groups aur sehat ki na-barabariyan pehchanti hai aur policymakers ko saboot deti hai (22.1.2).

book_ref.quote: It identifies vulnerable groups and health disparities

blocks.prompt:
18 Environmental health uses biostatistics to assess how which factors affect human health?
(Environmental health biostatistics se kin awamil ka insani sehat par asar jaanchti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Environmental health jaanchti hai ke pollution (aaloodgi) aur toxins (zehreele maddey) jaise awamil insani sehat ko kaise mutasir karte hain (22.1.2).

book_ref.quote: how environmental factors like pollution and toxins affect human health

blocks.prompt:
19 In bioinformatics, biostatistics supports the analysis of vast biological datasets from:
(Bioinformatics mein biostatistics kin bare biological datasets ke analysis mein madad deti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Bioinformatics mein biostatistics genomics aur proteomics ke bare biological datasets ke analysis mein madad deti hai (22.1.2).

book_ref.quote: analysis of vast biological datasets from genomics and proteomics

blocks.prompt:
20 Evaluating diagnostic test accuracies and tracking patient outcomes is an application of biostatistics in:
(Diagnostic tests ki durusti jaanchna aur mareezon ke nataij par nazar rakhna biostatistics ka kis shobe mein istemal hai?)
blocks.explanation: Healthcare quality control mein statistical tools se diagnostic tests ki durusti, mareezon ke nataij aur procedures ki yaksaaniyat dekhi jati hai (22.1.2).

book_ref.quote: evaluate diagnostic test accuracies, track patient outcomes

blocks.prompt:
21 Biostatistics helps public health officials understand the impact of:
(Biostatistics public health officials ko kis cheez ka asar samajhne mein madad deti hai?)

options.text: immunization mohimein aur sehat ki taleem

blocks.explanation: Yeh officials ko immunization (hifazati teeke) mohimon, sehat ki taleem aur healthcare workers ki training ka asar samajhne mein madad deti hai (22.1.2).

book_ref.quote: understand the impact of immunization campaigns, health education efforts

blocks.prompt:
22 During epidemics, biostatistics is critical in tracking the spread of disease, identifying at-risk populations and estimating:
(Wabaon ke dauran biostatistics bimari ke phailao, khatre wali population aur kis cheez ke andaze mein ahem hai?)
blocks.explanation: Wabaon mein biostatistics bimari ka phailao dekhti, mortality rates (sharah-e-amwaat) ka andaza lagati aur khatre wali population pehchanti hai (22.1.2).

book_ref.quote: estimating mortality rates, and identifying at-risk populations

blocks.prompt:
23 Biostatistics uncovers barriers to healthcare access by analyzing:
(Biostatistics healthcare tak rasai ki rukawatein kis ke analysis se dhoondti hai?)

options.text: survey data aur health services ke istemal ke patterns

blocks.explanation: Yeh survey data aur health services ke istemal ke patterns ka analysis kar ke rukawatein dhoondti hai (22.1.2).

book_ref.quote: by analyzing survey data and health service usage patterns

blocks.prompt:
24 In health risk assessment and demography, biostatistics analyses trends in:
(Health risk assessment aur demography mein biostatistics kin rujhanat ka analysis karti hai?)

options.text: paidaish, amwaat, bimari ka phailao aur doosre vital statistics
mukhtalif mittiyon mein paudon ki oonchai

blocks.explanation: Biostatistics paidaish, amwaat, bimari ke phailao aur doosre vital statistics ke rujhanat ka analysis karti hai (22.1.2).

book_ref.quote: analyzing trends in births, deaths, disease prevalence, and other vital statistics

blocks.text: 22.2 Key statistical measures and their calculation

blocks.prompt:
25 Which two measures describe the spread and dispersion of data?
(Data ke phailao aur bikhrao ko kaun se do measures bayan karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Standard deviation aur range data ka phailao aur bikhrao naapte hain; mean, median aur mode markazi qeematein hain (22.2).

book_ref.quote: Standard deviation and range measure the spread and dispersion of data

blocks.prompt:
26 Which measure breaks the data into specific intervals for a deeper analysis?
(Kaun sa measure data ko gehre analysis ke liye makhsoos hisson (intervals) mein baant deta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Percentiles data ko gehre analysis ke liye makhsoos intervals mein baant dete hain (22.2).

book_ref.quote: while percentiles break the data into specific intervals for a deeper analysis

blocks.prompt:
27 The mean, also known as the average, is a measure of:
(Mean, jise average bhi kehte hain, kis cheez ka measure hai?)
blocks.explanation: Mean central tendency (markazi rujhan) ka measure hai jo data ki markazi qeemat batata hai (22.2.1).

book_ref.quote: The mean, also known as the average, is a measure of central tendency

blocks.prompt:
28 In the formula for the mean of grouped data, xᵢ stands for the:
(Grouped data ke mean ke formula mein xᵢ kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Grouped data mein xᵢ ith class interval ka midpoint (darmiyani nuqta) hai aur fᵢ us ki frequency (22.2.1).

book_ref.quote: xᵢ = midpoint of the ith class interval.

blocks.prompt:
29 The masses of four fish are 220 g, 250 g, 270 g and 260 g. Their mean mass is:
(Chaar machhliyon ka wazan 220 g, 250 g, 270 g aur 260 g hai. Un ka mean wazan kya hai?)

book_ref.quote: Step 1: Add all the weights together (ΣX)

blocks.prompt:
30 The midpoint of the class interval 20–30 cm is:
(Class interval 20–30 cm ka midpoint kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Midpoint = (lower limit + upper limit)/2 = (20 + 30)/2 = 25 cm (22.2.1).

book_ref.quote: Step 2: Calculate the midpoint of each class interval.

blocks.prompt:
31 For a grouped dataset Σfᵢxᵢ = 360 and Σfᵢ = 18. The mean is:
(Aik grouped data mein Σfᵢxᵢ = 360 aur Σfᵢ = 18 hai. Mean kya hai?)

book_ref.quote: Step 5: Divide the result of the step 4 by the total frequency.

blocks.prompt:
32 The median represents:
(Median kis cheez ko zahir karta hai?)

options.text: tarteeb wali data ki darmiyani qeemat
sab se zyada aane wali qeemat
qeematon ka majmua un ki tadaad se taqseem
sab se bari aur sab se chhoti qeemat ka farq

blocks.explanation: Median tarteeb di gayi data ki darmiyani qeemat hai (22.2.2).

book_ref.quote: represents the middle value in a dataset when the data is arranged in order

blocks.prompt:
33 The median gives a better representation of central tendency for population size, disease prevalence or body measurements when the data:
(Population size, bimari ke phailao ya jism ki pemaishon mein median kab behtar markazi qeemat deta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Jab data normal distribution mein na ho to median behtar markazi qeemat deta hai (22.2.2).

book_ref.quote: where data might not be normally distributed

blocks.prompt:
34 Which statement about calculating the median is correct?
(Median nikalne ke baare mein kaun sa bayan durust hai?)

options.text: koi aik formula nahi, balke qadam hain

blocks.explanation: Median ka koi aik formula nahi, balke us ke qadam (steps) hain (22.2.2).

book_ref.quote: There is no single formula to calculate the median but there are steps to calculate it.

blocks.prompt:
35 The first step in calculating the median is to:
(Median nikalne ka pehla qadam kya hai?)

options.text: data ko barhti ya ghatti tarteeb mein lagana

blocks.explanation: Pehla qadam: data ko barhti ya ghatti tarteeb mein lagayein (22.2.2).

book_ref.quote: Step 1: Arrange the dataset in ascending or descending order.

blocks.prompt:
36 For an odd number of values n, the median is the value at the position:
(Taaq (odd) tadaad n ke liye median kis position par hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Agar n taaq ho to median ((n + 1)/2)th position wali qeemat hai (22.2.2).

book_ref.quote: If the number of values in the dataset is odd, the median is the value at the position

blocks.prompt:
37 In an ordered set of 8 values, the median is the average of the values at which positions?
(8 qeematon ke tarteeb wale set mein median kin positions ki qeematon ka average hai?)
blocks.explanation: Juft (even) n ke liye darmiyani qeematein n/2 aur n/2 + 1 par hain, yani n = 8 mein 4th aur 5th (22.2.2, book correction).

book_ref.quote: For an even number of values the two middle values are at the positions

blocks.prompt:
38 The lengths (cm) of seven leaves are 12, 18, 9, 15, 21, 11 and 14. The median length is:
(Saat patton ki lambai (cm) 12, 18, 9, 15, 21, 11 aur 14 hai. Median lambai kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Tarteeb: 9, 11, 12, 14, 15, 18, 21; n = 7 (taaq), position (7 + 1)/2 = 4th, is liye median = 14 cm (22.2.2).

book_ref.quote: Step 2: Count the total number of values in the dataset.

blocks.prompt:
39 The masses (g) of eight mice are 22, 35, 28, 40, 31, 26, 38 and 33. The median mass is:
(Aath choohon ka wazan (g) 22, 35, 28, 40, 31, 26, 38 aur 33 hai. Median wazan kya hai?)

book_ref.quote: the median is the average of values at the positions

blocks.prompt:
40 Which is a biological use of the mode given in the book?
(Kitab mein mode ka kaun sa biological istemal diya gaya hai?)

options.text: mean ke gird paudon ki oonchai ka phailao
woh qeemat jis se neeche 25% data ho
paude par phoolon ki sab se zyada aane wali tadaad
sab se bhari aur halke janwar ka farq

blocks.explanation: Mode sab se aam khasiyat batata hai, jaise paude par phoolon ki sab se zyada aane wali tadaad ya beejon ka aam size (22.2.3).

book_ref.quote: such as the most frequent number of flowers on a plant

blocks.prompt:
41 For ungrouped data, the mode is found by:
(Ungrouped data mein mode kaise maloom hota hai?)

options.text: l + (fm − f₁)/[(fm − f₁) + (fm − f₂)] × h lagakar
Σx ko n se taqseem kar ke
sab se zyada baar aane wali qeemat chun kar
variance ka square root le kar

blocks.explanation: Ungrouped data ke liye koi khaas formula nahi; mode woh qeemat hai jo sab se zyada baar aaye (22.2.3).

book_ref.quote: There is no specific formula to calculate mode in ungrouped data.

blocks.prompt:
42 In the formula for the mode of grouped data, l is the:
(Grouped data ke mode ke formula mein l kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: l = modal class ki lower boundary (nichli had); fm us ki frequency; h class width (22.2.3).

book_ref.quote: l = lower boundary of the modal class.

blocks.prompt:
43 The modal class of grouped data is the class with the:
(Grouped data ki modal class kaun si hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Modal class woh class hai jis ki frequency sab se zyada ho (22.2.3, book correction: 'modal', 'model' nahi).

book_ref.quote: the modal class with the highest frequency

blocks.prompt:
44 In the grouped-data mode formula, f₂ is the frequency of the:
(Grouped data ke mode formula mein f₂ kis ki frequency hai?)

options.text: modal class ke baad wali class
modal class se pehle wali class

blocks.explanation: f₁ modal class se pehle wali class ki aur f₂ us ke baad wali class ki frequency hai (22.2.3).

book_ref.quote: f₂ = frequency of the class after the modal class.

blocks.prompt:
45 For class intervals 10–15, 15–20, 20–25 …, the class width h is:
(Class intervals 10–15, 15–20, 20–25 … ke liye class width h kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: h = kisi bhi class interval ki upper limit − lower limit = 15 − 10 = 5 (22.2.3).

book_ref.quote: h = class width (the difference between upper and lower limits of any class interval).

blocks.prompt:
46 The numbers of seeds in eight pods are 6, 7, 5, 7, 8, 7, 6 and 5. The mode is:
(Aath phaliyon mein beejon ki tadaad 6, 7, 5, 7, 8, 7, 6 aur 5 hai. Mode kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: 7 teen baar aata hai, baqi se zyada (6 aur 5 do baar, 8 aik baar), is liye mode = 7 (22.2.3).

book_ref.quote: Step 2: Count the frequency of each value.

blocks.prompt:
47 Classes 0–10, 10–20, 20–30, 30–40 and 40–50 have frequencies 4, 9, 15, 11 and 6. The modal class is:
(Classes 0–10, 10–20, 20–30, 30–40 aur 40–50 ki frequencies 4, 9, 15, 11 aur 6 hain. Modal class kaun si hai?)
blocks.explanation: Modal class ki frequency sab se zyada hoti hai: 15, yani class 20–30 (22.2.3).

book_ref.quote: Step 1: Identify the modal class.
Step 2: Put the values in the formula to calculate mode for grouped data.

blocks.prompt:
49 A low standard deviation indicates that the data are:
(Kam standard deviation kya zahir karti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Kam SD ka matlab data mean ke gird qareeb jama hai; zyada SD ka matlab zyada phaila hua (22.2.4).

book_ref.quote: Low, or small, standard deviation indicates data are clustered tightly around the mean

blocks.prompt:
50 Of two normal curves with the same mean, the wider, more spread-out curve has:
(Aik hi mean wale do normal curves mein zyada chaura, phaila hua curve kya rakhta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Curve (a) zyada phaila hua hai to us ki SD zyada; curve (b) mean ke gird jama hai to SD kam (22.2.4).

book_ref.quote: more spread out, high standard deviation

blocks.prompt:
51 In biology, standard deviation is commonly used to assess:
(Biology mein standard deviation aam taur par kis ko jaanchne ke liye istemal hoti hai?)

options.text: beejon ka sab se aam size
paudon ki oonchai ki darmiyani qeemat
pemaishon ki variability, jaise enzyme concentration

blocks.explanation: SD pemaishon mein farq (variability) jaanchti hai, jaise paudon ki growth rates ya sample mein enzymes ki concentration (22.2.4).

book_ref.quote: the concentration of enzymes in a sample

blocks.prompt:
52 In the formula σ = √[Σ(xᵢ − µ)²/N], µ is the:
(Formula σ = √[Σ(xᵢ − µ)²/N] mein µ kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: σ = standard deviation, xᵢ = har data point, µ = mean, N = data points ki kul tadaad (22.2.4).

book_ref.quote: N = total number of data points.

blocks.prompt:
53 Each deviation from the mean is squared in calculating standard deviation because squaring:
(Standard deviation nikalte waqt har deviation ka square kyun liya jata hai?)

options.text: negative qeematein khatam aur bare deviations numayan karta hai
sab qeematein mean ke barabar karta hai
mean nikalne ki zaroorat khatam karta hai
data ko percentiles mein badalta hai

blocks.explanation: Square karne se negative qeematein khatam hoti hain aur bare deviations numayan hote hain (22.2.4).

book_ref.quote: which eliminates negative values and emphasizes larger deviations

blocks.prompt:
54 The average of the squared deviations, Σ(xᵢ − µ)²/N, is called the:
(Squared deviations ka average, Σ(xᵢ − µ)²/N, kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Squared deviations ka average variance hai; us ka square root standard deviation hai (22.2.4).

book_ref.quote: Step4: Find the average of the squared deviations.

blocks.prompt:
55 For the data 2, 4, 4, 4, 5, 5, 7, 9 (mean 5), the standard deviation is:
(Data 2, 4, 4, 4, 5, 5, 7, 9 (mean 5) ki standard deviation kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Squared deviations 9, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0, 4, 16 ka majmua 32; variance = 32/8 = 4; σ = √4 = 2 (22.2.4).

book_ref.quote: Step5: Take the square root of the result from step 4.

blocks.prompt:
56 The simplest form of variability, used to understand the extent of variation in a dataset, is the:
(Variability ki sab se saada shakal, jo data mein farq ki had samjhati hai, kaun si hai?)
blocks.explanation: Range variability ki sab se saada shakal hai: sab se bari aur sab se chhoti qeemat ka farq (22.2.5).

book_ref.quote: It is the simplest form of variability

blocks.prompt:
57 A larger range suggests that the data points are:
(Bari range kya zahir karti hai?)

options.text: markazi qeemat ke gird qareeb jama
aik doosre se zyada bikhre hue

blocks.explanation: Bari range zyada phailao batati hai; chhoti range ka matlab points markazi qeemat ke gird qareeb hain (22.2.5).

book_ref.quote: A larger range suggests a greater spread of data

blocks.prompt:
58 The pulse rates (beats/min) of six students are 72, 64, 88, 79, 95 and 70. The range is:
(Chhe talaba ki pulse rate (beats/min) 72, 64, 88, 79, 95 aur 70 hai. Range kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Range = Xmax − Xmin = 95 − 64 = 31 beats/min (22.2.5).

book_ref.quote: Step 3: Identify the smallest value in the dataset.

blocks.prompt:
59 To calculate the range one should:
(Range nikalne ke liye kya karna chahiye?)

options.text: sab se chhoti se sab se bari ghatana
bari aur chhoti qeemat jama karna
bari ko chhoti se taqseem karna
sab se bari qeemat se sab se chhoti ghatana

blocks.explanation: Range = Xmax − Xmin: sab se bari qeemat mein se sab se chhoti ghatayi jati hai (22.2.5, book correction).

book_ref.quote: subtract the minimum value from the maximum value

blocks.prompt:
60 A percentile indicates the value in a dataset:
(Percentile data ki kis qeemat ko zahir karta hai?)

options.text: jis se neeche diya gaya feesad hissa aaye
jo sab se zyada baar aaye
jo sab se bari observation ho

blocks.explanation: Percentile woh qeemat hai jis se neeche data ka diya gaya feesad hissa aata hai (22.2.6).

book_ref.quote: indicates the value in a dataset below which a given percentage of observations in a group of data falls

blocks.prompt:
61 The 25th percentile is also known as the:
(25th percentile ko aur kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: 25th percentile first quartile (Q1) hai, jis se neeche 25% data points hote hain (22.2.6).

book_ref.quote: the 25th percentile, also known as the first quartile (Q1)

blocks.prompt:
62 The value below which 75% of the data points lie is the:
(Woh qeemat jis se neeche 75% data points hon, kya kehlati hai?)
blocks.explanation: 75th percentile yani third quartile (Q3) woh qeemat hai jis se neeche 75% data points hon (22.2.6).

book_ref.quote: the 75th percentile, or the third quartile (Q3)

blocks.prompt:
63 In the rank formula R = (P/100)(n + 1), P stands for the:
(Rank formula R = (P/100)(n + 1) mein P kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: R = rank, P = matloob percentile, n = data set mein observations ki tadaad (22.2.6).
